# Jingyu API — AI gateway setup guide for coding agents

> This file is written for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.).
> The gateway origin is the same origin this file was fetched from, without a
> trailing slash. Below it is written as `<ORIGIN>`; replace it with that origin
> before running any command.

## What this gateway is

An OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API relay. One API key works on all routes.
A key is created from the web dashboard (API Keys page) or exchanged from a
one-time setup code (see "Setup code redemption" below).

## Base URLs

- OpenAI-compatible clients: `<ORIGIN>/v1`
- Anthropic clients (Claude Code): `<ORIGIN>` — do NOT append `/v1`; Claude Code
  posts to `/v1/messages` itself, so a suffix would produce `/v1/v1/messages`.

## Authentication

- OpenAI routes: `Authorization: Bearer sk-…`
- Anthropic route (`/v1/messages`): `x-api-key: sk-…` (plus `anthropic-version: 2023-06-01`)

Both headers may carry the same key.

## Endpoints

| Method | Path                    | Protocol                  | Used by            |
| ------ | ----------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------ |
| GET    | `/v1/models`            | OpenAI / Anthropic        | model list         |
| POST   | `/v1/chat/completions`  | OpenAI Chat Completions   | chat, tools, SSE   |
| POST   | `/v1/responses`         | OpenAI Responses          | Codex              |
| POST   | `/v1/messages`          | Anthropic Messages        | Claude Code        |

## Setup code redemption

If the user gives you a one-time setup code (16 characters, e.g. from the
docs page "Configure with AI" card), exchange it for a real key. The code is
single-use and expires in 10 minutes. Redeem it exactly once, then discard it:

```bash
curl -s <ORIGIN>/api/setup_code/redeem \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"code":"SETUP_CODE"}'
```

A successful reply is `{"success":true,"data":{"key":"sk-…"}}`. Use that key
for the configuration below. Do not commit the key to any repository, and do
not write it into files that get shared; prefer environment variables or the
tool's own credential store.

If you do not have a setup code, ask the user for an `sk-…` key instead. You
can check whether the account has quota by calling `GET /v1/models` with the
key; an auth error means the key is wrong, a quota error means the balance is
empty (the user must top up in the Wallet page).

## Tool configuration

### Claude Code

Add to `~/.claude/settings.json` (or export the same variables in the shell):

```json
{
  "env": {
    "ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL": "<ORIGIN>",
    "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "sk-xxxxxxxx",
    "ANTHROPIC_MODEL": "MODEL_ID"
  }
}
```

Keep `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` set to a model id from `GET /v1/models`.

### Codex

Codex uses the Responses API. Edit `~/.codex/config.toml`:

```toml
model = "MODEL_ID"
model_provider = "jingyu-api"

[model_providers.jingyu-api]
name = "Jingyu API"
base_url = "<ORIGIN>/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
env_key = "JINGYU_API_KEY"
```

Then export the key in the shell you launch Codex from:

```bash
export JINGYU_API_KEY=sk-xxxxxxxx      # macOS / Linux / WSL
# PowerShell: $env:JINGYU_API_KEY = "sk-xxxxxxxx"
```

### CC Switch / Magpie (GUI switchers)

CC Switch (https://ccswitch.io/zh/) and Magpie (https://usemagpie.ai/zh/) are
desktop apps that manage provider configs for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini
CLI. If the user has one installed, prefer its own import flow: add a custom
provider with base URL `<ORIGIN>/v1`, the OpenAI protocol, and the key.

### Other OpenAI-compatible tools

Set the base URL to `<ORIGIN>/v1` and the API key to the `sk-…` value, using
whatever mechanism the tool provides (config file, env var, UI settings).

## Verify the connection

After configuring, run one real request and confirm the reply shape:

```bash
curl -s <ORIGIN>/v1/chat/completions \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxxxxxx' \
  -d '{"model":"MODEL_ID","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Say OK"}]}'
```

A successful reply contains `"object": "chat.completion"` and a
`choices[0].message.content` field. Anything else is an error to report back to
the user (401: key wrong or disabled; quota error: balance empty; 404/400 on
model: model id not offered — pick one from `GET /v1/models`).

## Model ids

Fetch the current list with `GET /v1/models` (Bearer auth). Send the model id
exactly as listed, including the vendor prefix.
